description: The signed-in person's own clothes, most recently updated first, with category, colour, size, material, formality and warmth. Filter by category: a garment class ('tops', 'bottoms', 'dresses', 'outerwear', 'shoes', 'bags', 'hats', 'accessories') finds every item of that kind whatever its category is called, and any other word matches the category name (e.g. 'jeans', 'knitwear'). Also filter by colour, formality ('loungewear', 'casual', 'athletic', 'smart_casual', 'business', 'formal'), warmth ('very_light', 'light', 'medium', 'warm', 'very_warm'), favourites, or a word in the name. Paged: pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`. For an overview, call get_context first: it is one call instead of several pages.
